keyPoints: Trijyakhund (sector) do trijyaon aur chaap se ghira hissa hai — chaap ki lambai = (θ/360) x 2πr, poori paridhi ka kon-anupatik hissa — kendra par poora kon 360 hota hai.
Trijyakhund ka kshetrafal = (θ/360) x πr² — poore vritt ke kshetrafal ka kon-anupatik hissa, jaise 90 par ek-chauthai — 180 par aadha vritt milta hai.
Vrittakhund (segment) jya aur chaap ke beech ka hissa hai — laghu vrittakhund chhota, deergh vrittakhund bada hota hai.
Vrittakhund ka kshetrafal = trijyakhund ka kshetrafal - usme bane tribhuj ka kshetrafal — chitra bana kar samjho.
Ghadi ki sui, pankhe ke blade, pizza slice — rozmarra ke trijyakhund; khet ka gol tukda vrittakhund jaisa — kheton ki med me dikhta hai.
Gol daud-path (circular track) ke sawalon me paridhi, trijyakhund ka kshetrafal dono kaam aate hain.
Aam galti: kon ko radian me rakh kar sutra lagana — ye sutra degree (θ/360) ke liye hain.
subject: Maths
title: Trijyakhund aur Vrittakhund
